note: Initramfs firmware profiles for packaging/initramfs/build_initramfs.py. Required groups must be present and verified; optional groups are included only when present and verified, otherwise skipped and recorded.

cuh-1215a.description: NickLabs primary console: CUH-1215A, original (fat) CUH-12xx, Belize southbridge, Liverpool GPU, Marvell 88W8897 (Torus 2) Wi-Fi/BT
cuh-1215a.hardware_source: stated by Nick 2026-10-26 (system firmware 13.50, GoldHEN); not yet confirmed from console logs

aeolia-belize-generic.description: Any Aeolia/Belize console (CUH-10xx..12xx, CUH-2xxx Belize slims): GPU firmware required, Wi-Fi/BT firmware if present

firmware-free.description: Redistributable initramfs with no firmware at all. On ps4-linux-loader >= v24b the 8 core GPU microcode files and the EDID are extracted from the console at boot; hardware video decode/encode (UVD/VCE) and Wi-Fi/BT stay unavailable until firmware is installed.
